s: Preheat the oven to 150°C.
Roughly chop the hazelnuts and almonds.
Melt the coconut oil with the peanut butter over low heat, then add the cocoa, erythritol and salt.
Mix with the nuts, pumpkin seeds, coconut and flaxseed.
Spread on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 18 to 20 minutes, stirring halfway through (keep an eye on it: cocoa burns quickly).
Let cool completely before transferring to a jar.
l02-granola-cacao-noisette.p: Add a few crushed squares of 85% dark chocolate once the granola has cooled.

s: Cut the avocado in half, remove the pit and scoop out the flesh.
Blend the avocado, frozen raspberries, coconut milk, erythritol and lemon juice until you get a very thick cream (scrape down the sides if needed).
Pour into two bowls: the texture should hold on a spoon.
Top with chia seeds and shredded coconut.
Serve immediately, well chilled.
l02-smoothie-bowl-framboise-avocat.p: Frozen fruit gives an ice-cream texture; if using fresh fruit, add 3 ice cubes.

s: Put all the ingredients in the blender, adding the ice cubes last.
Blend for 1 minute on full power until the smoothie is smooth and thick.
Taste and adjust the sweetener if needed.
Serve in two large glasses with a wide straw.
l02-smoothie-epais-cacahuete-cacao.p: The avocado gives a velvety texture with no noticeable taste. Add 20 g of whey for a higher-protein version.

l02-smoothie-vert-epinard-coco.t: Green Spinach, Coconut and Lemon Smoothie
s: Rinse the spinach and mint.
Place all the ingredients in the blender with a few ice cubes.
Blend for 1 minute until you have a thick, perfectly smooth drink.
Taste, adjust the lemon or sweetener, then serve right away.
l02-smoothie-vert-epinard-coco.p: Fresh spinach has almost no taste once blended: ideal for getting children to eat vegetables.

s: Preheat the oven to 175°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix the almond flour, psyllium, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
Add the egg whites and vinegar and mix: the dough looks like a thick crumble dough.
Pour in the boiling water and mix vigorously with a spatula for 1 minute: the dough becomes supple and holds together.
With wet hands, shape an oval loaf or 8 small rolls. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 55 to 60 minutes (40 minutes for small rolls): the bread should sound hollow when tapped underneath.
Let cool completely on a rack before slicing, otherwise the crumb seems damp.
l02-pain-psyllium-classique.p: Use finely ground psyllium powder, not whole husks. Sliced and frozen, it can be toasted straight from the freezer.

s: Preheat the oven to 150°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Carefully separate the whites from the yolks (no trace of yolk in the whites).
Whisk the yolks with the softened cream cheese until perfectly smooth.
Beat the whites with the baking powder and salt to very stiff peaks: the bowl turned upside down should not drip.
Gently fold the yolk mixture into the whites in three additions, lifting with a spatula.
Form 8 discs 10 cm wide and 1.5 cm thick on the baking sheet.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden and firm to the touch. Let cool on the sheet.
l02-pain-nuage.p: Left for 24 hours in a closed container, cloud bread becomes softer, ideal for sandwiches or sweet toasts.

s: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Melt the mozzarella with the cream cheese in the microwave for 1 minute, stir, then another 30 seconds until you have a smooth mass.
Add the almond flour, baking powder and egg, and knead quickly with a spatula and then by hand (oiled) until the dough is uniform.
Divide into 6 balls, roll each into a 20 cm rope and join the ends into a ring, pinching to seal.
Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle generously with sesame seeds.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until well golden.
Let cool for 10 minutes before cutting: the crumb firms up as it cools.
l02-bagels-fathead-sesame.p: If the dough becomes too stiff to work, warm it for 10 seconds in the microwave. Top with cream cheese and raspberries for a sweet breakfast.

s: Melt the butter directly in a mug or a flat-bottomed ramekin (20 seconds in the microwave).
Add the almond flour, baking powder, salt and egg, then mix with a fork until no lumps remain.
Microwave for 90 seconds on full power: the bread should be risen and firm in the center.
Turn out, let cool for 2 minutes and cut into two slices.
Toast the slices in a pan with a little butter for a crisp result.
l02-pain-en-tasse-90s.p: Add 1 tsp erythritol and some cinnamon for an express French toast: dip the slices in beaten egg and brown them in a pan.

s: In a large bowl, mix all the seeds, the crushed almonds, the psyllium and the salt.
Add the olive oil and water and mix well: the dough becomes compact within a few minutes.
Pour into a loaf pan lined with parchment paper and press down firmly with the back of a wet spoon.
Let rest for at least 2 hours (or overnight) at room temperature so the seeds hydrate.
Preheat the oven to 175°C and bake for 20 minutes.
Turn the bread out, remove the paper and put it back directly on the oven rack for 40 minutes, until it sounds hollow.
Let cool completely before slicing thinly.
l02-pain-graines-sans-farine.p: This bread keeps for 5 days in the fridge and can be frozen sliced. Toasted, it is perfect with butter and a little almond butter.

l02-baghrir-keto.t: Keto Baghrir with a Thousand Holes
s: Blend the almond flour, coconut flour, psyllium, eggs, almond milk, erythritol and salt in a blender for 1 minute.
Let rest for 10 minutes, then add the baking powder and vinegar and blend again for 10 seconds: the batter should be as fluid as a thick crepe batter and foamy.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, with no fat.
Pour in a small ladle of batter without spreading it. Cook on one side only, without flipping, for 2 to 3 minutes until the surface is covered with holes and completely dry.
Place each baghrir on a clean tea towel, holes facing up, without stacking them while they are hot.
Syrup: melt the butter with the erythritol and argan oil over low heat.
Drizzle the baghrir with hot syrup just before serving.
l02-baghrir-keto.p: The holes form thanks to the baking powder-vinegar reaction: add them at the last moment and cook the batter right away.

l02-harcha-keto.t: Keto Harcha with Flaxseed and Almond
s: Mix the almond flour, flaxseed, shredded coconut, baking powder, erythritol and salt.
Add the melted butter and rub in with your fingertips, then add the egg and almond milk. Form a supple dough that holds together.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then shape 6 patties 1 cm thick between your hands.
Roll the edges in a little shredded coconut to imitate the look of semolina.
Cook in a heavy-bottomed pan over low heat for 5 to 6 minutes per side, until well golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes before splitting them open: they firm up as they cool.
l02-harcha-keto.p: Serve with jben, a drizzle of argan oil or butter, and unsweetened mint tea.

s: Blend the fromage blanc, eggs, almond flour, psyllium, water and salt until you have a smooth, fairly liquid batter.
Let rest for 10 minutes, then whisk in the baking powder and lemon juice in one go.
In a hot, ungreased non-stick pan, pour a ladle of batter and cook on one side only for 2 to 3 minutes, until holes appear and the top dries.
Place on a tea towel without stacking.
Melt the smen with the almond butter and drizzle over the beghrir while still warm.
l02-beghrir-fromage-blanc.p: The fromage blanc makes these beghrir higher in protein and fluffier than the almond-only version; a different take to vary your weekend breakfasts.

s: Prepare the keto amlou: mix the almond butter, argan oil and erythritol.
Melt the mozzarella and cream cheese in the microwave for 1 min 30, stirring halfway, then knead with the almond flour and egg.
Divide into 6 balls. Roll each one out between two sheets of parchment paper into a thin 12 × 20 cm rectangle.
Spread with a thin layer of keto amlou, then roll up lengthwise and coil the rope into a snail shape.
Gently flatten the snail with your palm into a 10 cm disc.
Brown in a pan in the butter over medium-low heat, 3 to 4 minutes per side.
Serve warm.
l02-rghaif-keto-amlou.p: Prepare the snails the day before, keep them covered with cling film in the refrigerator and cook them in the morning in 8 minutes.

l02-khobz-keto-anis.t: Keto Khobz with Aniseed and Sesame
s: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Mix the almond flour, psyllium, flaxseed, baking powder, aniseed and salt.
Add the eggs, vinegar and oil, then the hot water, and mix vigorously until you have a supple dough.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then with oiled hands shape a round loaf 2 cm thick, like a khobz.
Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, prick the surface with a fork and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until the bread is well golden and sounds hollow.
Let cool on a rack before cutting into wedges.
l02-khobz-keto-anis.p: Makes 8 servings. Cut in half horizontally and toasted, it goes perfectly with the butter and jben at breakfast.

s: Mix the flours, psyllium and salt. Add the warm water and olive oil and knead for 1 minute: the dough firms up as it rests for 10 minutes.
Divide into 4 balls. On oiled parchment paper, roll out each ball into a very thin disc.
Brush with ghee, roll into a tight rope, then coil the rope on itself into a spiral.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then flatten the spiral by hand into a 12 cm disc.
Cook in a hot, lightly greased pan for 3 minutes per side over medium heat.
Serve hot, drizzled with ghee and erythritol or with a fresh cheese.
l02-meloui-keto-coco.p: An egg-free and cheese-free version, closer to the traditional dough; ideal if someone at home avoids dairy (replace the ghee with coconut oil).

s: Preheat the oven to 170°C and butter a loaf pan.
Whisk the softened butter, cream cheese and erythritol until creamy.
Add the eggs one at a time, whisking, then the orange blossom water.
Mix the almond flour, whey, psyllium, baking powder and salt separately, then fold into the creamed mixture. Let rest for 5 minutes.
With wet hands, form 3 ropes and braid them in the pan, or form 8 tightly packed balls.
Brush with egg yolk and bake for 30 to 35 minutes: a knife blade should come out dry. Cover with aluminum foil halfway through if it browns too quickly.
Let cool for 20 minutes in the pan before unmolding.
l02-brioche-keto-fleur-oranger.p: The whey gives a stretchier crumb, close to a real brioche. Sliced and toasted, it is perfect for French toast.

s: Preheat the oven to 175°C and line a 10-cup muffin pan with paper liners.
Whisk the eggs, melted butter, cream, vanilla and lemon zest.
Add the almond flour, erythritol, baking powder and salt. Mix without overworking.
Gently fold in the blueberries with a spatula.
Fill the liners three-quarters full.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, until the muffins are golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes in the pan, then on a rack.
l02-muffins-myrtille-amande.p: Frozen blueberries work too: add them without thawing so they don't color the batter. Replace them with raspberries for fewer carbs.

s: Preheat the oven to 175°C and prepare 8 paper liners.
Whisk the eggs with the erythritol until slightly pale.
Add the melted coconut oil, yogurt, and the lemon juice and zest.
Fold in the coconut flour, shredded coconut, baking powder and salt. Let rest for 5 minutes: the batter thickens.
Divide among the liners and sprinkle with a little shredded coconut.
Bake for 20 to 22 minutes, until the tops are golden.
Let cool completely: coconut flour needs time to set.
l02-muffins-citron-coco.p: A quick glaze: mix 1 tbsp powdered erythritol with a few drops of lemon juice.

s: Preheat the oven to 175°C.
Grate the zucchini, salt lightly and squeeze it hard in a tea towel to remove as much water as possible.
Whisk the eggs, coconut oil, erythritol and vanilla.
Add the almond flour, cinnamon and baking powder, then the zucchini and the chopped walnuts.
Fill 10 liners and bake for 25 minutes.
Let cool on a rack before enjoying.
l02-muffins-courgette-cannelle.p: Squeezing the zucchini well is essential, otherwise the muffins stay damp in the center. Kids won't even notice it!

s: Preheat the oven to 175°C and prepare 8 paper liners.
Whisk the eggs, melted butter, almond milk and erythritol.
Sift the cocoa with the almond flour, baking powder and salt, then fold into the mixture.
Chop the chocolate and add two-thirds of it to the batter.
Fill the liners and sprinkle with the remaining chocolate.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes: the center should stay slightly gooey.
l02-muffins-double-chocolat.p: A weekend breakfast: serve warm with a glass of almond milk.

s: Make the bread: in a square dish, mix the almond flour, baking powder, 1 egg and 10 g melted butter, then microwave for 90 seconds. Let cool and cut into 4 slices.
Beat the remaining 2 eggs with the cream, erythritol, cinnamon and vanilla in a shallow dish.
Dip each slice for 10 seconds on each side in the mixture.
Melt the remaining butter in a pan over medium heat and brown the slices for 2 minutes per side.
Serve hot, dusted with an erythritol-cinnamon mix and a few raspberries.
l02-pain-perdu-brioche-keto.p: You can use slices of keto brioche or day-old psyllium bread: they soak up the mixture even better.

s: Oil a round ramekin 10 cm wide.
Mix the flaxseed, almond flour, baking powder and salt with a fork, then add the egg, oil and water.
Microwave for 2 minutes, until the center is firm.
Turn out, cut in half horizontally and toast in the toaster or in a pan.
Top with butter and almond butter, or with cream cheese.
l02-english-muffin-lin.p: The texture, more rustic than almond mug bread, is reminiscent of a whole-grain muffin.

s: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Mix the almond flour, coconut flour, erythritol, baking powder and salt. Add the cold butter and rub in with your fingertips.
Add the egg beaten with the cream and vanilla, and form a ball without overkneading.
Gently fold in the raspberries, crushing them as little as possible.
Flatten into a disc 3 cm thick on parchment paper and cut into 8 triangles, spaced slightly apart.
Refrigerate for 10 minutes, then bake for 18 to 20 minutes until the scones are golden.
Let cool for 15 minutes before moving.
l02-scones-amande-framboise.p: Chilling before baking keeps the scones from spreading. Delicious with a little mascarpone.

s: Whisk the eggs and fromage blanc, then add the whey, almond flour and baking powder.
Let rest for 3 minutes: the batter should be thick but pourable.
Heat a pan over medium-low heat with a little coconut oil.
Pour small ladles and cook for 2 minutes, until bubbles appear, then flip and cook for 1 minute (whey dries out if cooked too long).
Serve with the raspberries.
l02-pancakes-whey-proteines.p: Perfect after a morning workout. Don't cook over high heat: the whey burns and turns rubbery.

s: In a bowl, mix the chia, flaxseed, shredded coconut, flaked almonds, cinnamon and erythritol.
Add the Greek yogurt and almond milk and mix well.
Divide between two jars, close and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, stir, add a splash of milk if too thick and place a spoonful of almond butter on top.
Enjoy cold or heated for 1 minute in the microwave.
l02-overnight-noats-amande.p: "Noats" is the name for these "no-oat" porridges. Prepare 4 jars at once: they keep for 3 days.

s: In a small saucepan, heat the ricotta, cream, coffee and flaxseed over low heat, stirring, for 2 to 3 minutes.
Sweeten with the erythritol: the mixture should be creamy and thick.
Dry-toast the hazelnuts for 3 minutes.
Pour the porridge into two bowls, sprinkle with hazelnuts and dust with cocoa.
l02-porridge-ricotta-noisette-cafe.p: A "tiramisu" version of breakfast; use decaf coffee for children.

s: Preheat the oven to 170°C.
Mix the coconut, almond flour, chia, erythritol and salt.
Add the eggs, melted coconut oil and vanilla, and mix until you have a moist dough that holds together.
Form 8 balls, place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and flatten them into 1.5 cm patties.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes until the edges are golden.
Let cool on the sheet: they firm up as they cool.
l02-galettes-chia-coco-four.p: The ideal grab-and-go breakfast: 2 patties with a Greek yogurt. They keep for 5 days in a container.

i: spice mix: 4-spice blend, cinnamon, aniseed and ground ginger
s: Preheat the oven to 165°C and line a loaf pan with parchment paper.
Whisk the eggs with the erythritol, then add the melted butter, almond milk and grated ginger.
Mix the flours, spices, baking powder and salt, then fold into the liquid mixture.
Pour into the pan, smooth the top and sprinkle with flaked almonds.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, covering with aluminum foil after 25 minutes.
Let cool completely and wrap in cling film: it is better the next day.
l02-pain-epices-keto.p: Sliced and toasted with butter, it makes a comforting winter breakfast.

s: Blend the eggs, cream cheese and almond flour until you have a smooth batter.
Cook 6 thin crepes in a small buttered pan, 1 minute 30 on one side and 30 seconds on the other.
Mash the jben with a fork with the chopped mint and erythritol.
Spread the filling on each crepe and roll them up.
Drizzle with argan oil just before serving.
l02-crepes-jben-menthe.p: Jben is available from any dairy shop; drain it well if it is very wet.

s: Place all the ingredients in the blender.
Blend for 1 minute until smooth and thick, like a milkshake.
Taste and adjust the sweetness.
Serve right away in two well-chilled glasses.
l02-smoothie-fraise-ricotta.p: Ricotta provides protein and a creamy texture without the tangy taste of yogurt.

s: Preheat the oven to 180°C and butter a 22 cm round pan.
Melt the mozzarella with 60 g of cream cheese in the microwave for 1 min 30, then knead with the almond flour, baking powder and egg.
Roll the dough out between two sheets of parchment paper into a 25 × 35 cm rectangle.
Mix the softened butter with 3 tbsp erythritol and the cinnamon, then spread over the dough.
Roll up lengthwise using the paper to help, then cut into 8 pieces with a thin knife.
Arrange them in the pan and bake for 18 to 20 minutes until golden.
Frosting: whisk 50 g of cream cheese with the remaining erythritol and the vanilla, then spread over the warm rolls.
l02-brioches-cannelle-roulees.p: Put the log in the freezer for 15 minutes before cutting: the slices will be neat and perfectly round.

s: In a large mug, whisk the egg, peanut butter and almond milk with a fork.
Add the almond flour, erythritol and baking powder and mix until smooth.
Press half of the raspberries into the batter.
Microwave for 70 to 90 seconds: the top should be just set.
Let cool for 1 minute and top with the remaining raspberries.
l02-mug-cake-matin-cacahuete.p: Ready in 5 minutes, ideal for rushed mornings. Don't cook it longer, or it will turn dry.

s: Preheat the waffle iron.
Whisk the eggs, melted butter, almond milk and 3 tbsp erythritol, then add the almond flour, 2 tbsp cocoa and the baking powder.
Cook ladles of batter for 4 to 5 minutes in the lightly buttered waffle iron.
Cream: blend the avocado flesh with 1 tbsp cocoa and the remaining erythritol until you have a smooth mousse.
Serve the waffles warm, topped with avocado cream and sprinkled with hazelnuts.
l02-gaufres-cacao-noisette-avocat.p: The avocado-cocoa cream keeps for 24 hours in the fridge with cling film pressed directly onto the surface to keep it from darkening.

l03-poulet-roti-beurre-herbes.t: Roast Chicken with Herb Butter and Lemon
s: Take the chicken out of the refrigerator 30 minutes ahead and preheat the oven to 200°C.
Mash the softened butter with the pressed garlic, parsley, lemon zest, thyme, paprika, salt and pepper.
Gently loosen the skin over the breasts with your fingers and slide half of the herb butter underneath; spread the rest over the thighs.
Place the squeezed lemon half inside the cavity, tie the legs together and set the chicken in a dish, drizzled with the lemon juice and the oil.
Roast for 1 h 15 to 1 h 20, basting with the pan juices every 20 minutes.
Check doneness: the juices running from the pierced thigh should be clear (74°C at the core).
Let rest for 10 minutes under aluminum foil before carving and serve with the cooking juices.
l03-poulet-roti-beurre-herbes.p: Serve with green beans or cauliflower mash. Shredded leftovers make an excellent salad the next day.

l03-cuisses-paprika-chou-fleur.t: Crispy Paprika Chicken Thighs with Roasted Cauliflower
i: smoked paprika, cumin and garlic powder
s: Preheat the oven to 210°C. Pat the thighs thoroughly dry with paper towels (this is the secret to crispy skin).
Mix 2 tbsp oil with the spices, salt and pepper; rub it over the thighs.
Toss the cauliflower florets with the remaining oil, salt and a pinch of paprika.
Arrange the thighs skin side up on a baking sheet with the cauliflower around them, without crowding.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, turning the cauliflower halfway through, until the skin is golden and the juices run clear.
Drizzle with lemon juice, sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve piping hot.
l03-cuisses-paprika-chou-fleur.p: For even more crispness, leave the salted thighs uncovered in the refrigerator for 2 hours before cooking.

s: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with oiled parchment paper.
Cut the chicken into 3 to 4 cm pieces, season with salt and pepper.
Beat the eggs in a shallow dish; in another, mix the almond flour, Parmesan and spices.
Dip each piece in the egg, let drain, then roll it in the crumb mixture, pressing well.
Arrange on the baking sheet, brush or spray with oil and bake for 18 to 20 minutes, turning halfway through.
Mix the mayonnaise and mustard for the sauce and serve the golden nuggets with a salad.
l03-nuggets-amande-parmesan.p: Raw breaded nuggets can be frozen flat: bake them straight from frozen, 5 minutes longer.

l03-brochettes-poulet-ail-citron.t: Garlic Lemon Chicken Skewers with Dill Yogurt Sauce
s: Cut the chicken into 3 cm cubes. Mix the oil, lemon juice and zest, pressed garlic, spices, salt and pepper; marinate the chicken for at least 1 hour in the fridge.
Cut the bell pepper into squares and the zucchini into thick slices.
Thread the chicken and vegetables alternately onto skewers (soak wooden ones in water for 20 minutes).
Cook on a very hot grill or grill pan for 12 to 15 minutes, turning regularly.
Mix the yogurt with the dill, a pinch of salt and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve the skewers with the well-chilled yogurt sauce.
l03-brochettes-poulet-ail-citron.p: The marinade can be prepared the day before: the chicken will only be more tender.

l03-salade-cesar-poulet.t: Keto Caesar Salad with Grilled Chicken
s: Season the breasts with salt, pepper and oil, then grill them for 5 to 6 minutes per side in a hot pan. Let rest for 5 minutes and slice.
Make the dressing: mix the mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard, pressed garlic, 1 tbsp grated Parmesan and 1 tbsp water.
Wash, spin dry and chop the romaine.
Peel the hard-boiled eggs and cut them into quarters.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing, divide among plates and add the chicken, eggs, Parmesan shavings and pumpkin seeds.
l03-salade-cesar-poulet.p: Toasted pumpkin seeds replace the croutons. Keep the dressing separate if you prepare the salad in advance.

s: Preheat the oven to 190°C and butter a baking dish.
Cook the broccoli florets for 4 minutes in salted boiling water or steam them; they should stay crisp. Drain well.
Dice the chicken (chicken poached or roasted the day before is perfect).
In a saucepan, heat the cream with the cream cheese, pressed garlic, nutmeg, salt and pepper, whisking until you have a smooth sauce. Add half of the cheddar.
Spread the broccoli and chicken in the dish, cover with the sauce and sprinkle with the remaining cheddar.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until the top is golden and bubbling.
l03-gratin-poulet-brocoli-cheddar.p: To cook the chicken quickly: poach it for 15 minutes in simmering broth.

l03-escalopes-dinde-moutarde.t: Turkey Cutlets in Old-Style Mustard Sauce
s: Cook the green beans for 8 to 10 minutes in salted boiling water, drain and keep warm.
Season the cutlets with salt and pepper. Melt the butter in a pan over medium-high heat.
Brown the cutlets for 3 minutes on each side, then set aside on a plate.
Deglaze the pan with the broth, scraping up the browned bits, and reduce for 2 minutes.
Add the crème fraîche and mustard, stir and let thicken for 2 minutes over low heat.
Return the cutlets to the sauce for 1 to 2 minutes, sprinkle with chives and serve with the green beans.
l03-escalopes-dinde-moutarde.p: Don't boil the sauce after adding the mustard: it would turn bitter.

l03-foies-volaille-champignons.t: Pan-Fried Chicken Livers with Mushrooms and Parsley
s: Clean the livers: remove the sinews and greenish parts, cut them in half and pat dry.
Sauté the sliced mushrooms in half of the butter for 6 minutes over high heat, season with salt and set aside.
In the same pan, heat the oil and the remaining butter until foaming.
Sear the livers for 2 minutes without touching them, flip them and continue cooking for 3 to 4 minutes: the center should no longer be pink (70°C at the core).
Add the chopped garlic and the mushrooms and deglaze with the vinegar; stir for 30 seconds.
Off the heat, add the chopped parsley, season with salt and pepper and serve on a bed of arugula.
l03-foies-volaille-champignons.p: Only salt the livers at the end of cooking so they stay tender.

s: Make the sauce: sauté the garlic in 1 tbsp oil, add the tomatoes, oregano, salt and pepper and reduce for 10 minutes.
Butterfly the breasts or flatten them to 1.5 cm thick. Season with salt and pepper.
Dip them in the beaten egg then in the almond flour-Parmesan mixture.
Brown them for 3 minutes per side in the remaining oil, then place them in a baking dish.
Top each breast with tomato sauce and cover with slices of mozzarella.
Bake for 15 minutes at 200°C, until the cheese is melted and golden. Sprinkle with fresh basil.
l03-poulet-parmigiana.p: Serve with sautéed zucchini or zucchini noodles.

s: Cut the chicken into pieces and marinate for 30 minutes (or overnight) with the yogurt, half of the spices and salt.
Brown the drained chicken in half of the butter for 6 minutes over high heat, then set aside.
In the same pot, melt the remaining butter and sweat the chopped onion for 4 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and remaining spices, stir for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes; cook for 8 minutes.
Blend the sauce until smooth, add the cream and return the chicken.
Simmer for 10 minutes over low heat, adjust the salt and serve sprinkled with cilantro.
l03-butter-chicken.p: Serve with cauliflower rice flavored with cardamom.

l03-salade-dinde-fumee-avocat.t: Hearty Smoked Turkey, Avocado and Soft-Boiled Egg Salad
s: Lower the eggs into boiling water for 6 minutes, then into ice water; peel them.
Whisk the oil, lemon, mustard, salt and pepper.
Divide the salad between two plates, add the sliced avocado and the halved tomatoes.
Roll up the turkey slices and arrange them, then place a soft-boiled egg cut in half on each salad.
Drizzle with the vinaigrette and sprinkle with sunflower seeds.
l03-salade-dinde-fumee-avocat.p: Squeeze lemon over the avocado if cut in advance to keep it from darkening.

l03-poulet-saute-gingembre-brocoli.t: Wok-Style Ginger Chicken and Broccoli Stir-Fry
s: Cut the chicken into thin strips and the broccoli into small florets.
Mix the soy sauce, vinegar, water, ginger and chopped garlic.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat, sear the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes until golden, set aside.
Add the remaining oil and the broccoli; stir-fry for 3 minutes, add 2 tbsp water, cover for 2 minutes.
Return the chicken, pour in the sauce and stir-fry for 1 to 2 minutes until it coats the chicken.
Sprinkle with sliced scallions and sesame seeds, serve immediately.
l03-poulet-saute-gingembre-brocoli.p: Check the label: choose a soy sauce with no added alcohol. Serve with konjac rice.

l03-poulet-tikka-four.t: Oven-Roasted Chicken Tikka with Cucumber Raita
s: Cut the chicken into large cubes. Mix 150 g of yogurt with the spices, garlic, ginger, lemon juice, oil and salt.
Coat the chicken in this marinade and let rest for at least 1 hour in the refrigerator (ideally overnight).
Preheat the oven to 220°C on the fan grill setting. Arrange the pieces on a rack set over a baking sheet.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, turning halfway through, until the edges are lightly charred.
Meanwhile, grate the cucumber, squeeze out the water and mix it with the remaining yogurt, the mint and a pinch of salt.
Serve the hot chicken tikka with the well-chilled raita.
l03-poulet-tikka-four.p: For barbecue skewers, thread the marinated cubes onto skewers and grill for 12 minutes.

l03-ailes-poulet-croustillantes.t: Crispy Oven-Baked Chicken Wings with Chive Dip
i: smoked paprika, garlic and onion powder
s: Preheat the oven to 220°C. Pat the wings very thoroughly dry with paper towels.
Mix the baking powder, spices and salt, then coat the wings by shaking them in a bowl.
Arrange them on a rack over a baking sheet, without touching. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, turning halfway through.
Melt the butter with the harissa and stir.
Make the dip: yogurt, mayonnaise, chopped chives, salt.
As soon as they come out of the oven, toss the wings in the spicy butter and serve with the dip and celery sticks.
l03-ailes-poulet-croustillantes.p: The baking powder (in a small amount) dries out the skin and makes it very crispy without deep-frying.

l03-poulet-farci-epinards-feta.t: Spinach and Feta Stuffed Chicken Breasts
s: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Wilt the spinach for 2 minutes in a pan with the chopped garlic, then squeeze out the water and chop.
Mix the spinach with the crumbled feta and the cream cheese.
Cut a pocket into the thickness of each breast, without cutting all the way through.
Fill the pockets with the stuffing and close with toothpicks.
Brush with oil, season with salt (a little, the feta is salty), pepper, paprika and oregano.
Sear for 2 minutes per side in an ovenproof pan, add the cherry tomatoes around.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until 74°C at the core. Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
l03-poulet-farci-epinards-feta.p: Replace the feta with jben for a milder version.

l03-boulettes-dinde-sauce-tomate.t: Turkey Meatballs in Tomato Basil Sauce
s: Mix the ground turkey, Parmesan, egg, almond flour, half of the garlic, chopped parsley, salt and pepper.
Shape about twenty meatballs with wet hands.
Brown them for 6 to 8 minutes in 1 tbsp oil, rolling them in the pan. Set aside.
Sauté the remaining garlic in the remaining oil, add the tomatoes, season with salt and simmer for 10 minutes.
Return the meatballs, cover and cook for 10 minutes over low heat. Add the mozzarella in pieces 2 minutes before the end.
Quickly pan-fry the zucchini noodles for 2 minutes and serve the meatballs on top, sprinkled with basil.
l03-boulettes-dinde-sauce-tomate.p: Ask the butcher to grind the turkey cutlets. Cooked meatballs can be frozen for 2 months.

l03-poulet-provencale-olives.t: Provençal Braised Chicken with Olives and Bell Peppers
s: Cut the thighs in two at the joint, season with salt and pepper.
In a Dutch oven, brown the pieces skin side down for 6 minutes in the oil, then flip for 3 minutes. Set aside.
Remove the excess fat, sauté the onion and bell peppers cut into strips for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and herbs for 1 minute, then the tomatoes and broth.
Return the chicken, cover and simmer for 30 minutes over low heat.
Add the olives, uncover and reduce for 10 minutes. Sprinkle with basil when serving.
l03-poulet-provencale-olives.p: Like all braised dishes, it is even better reheated.

l03-bowl-poulet-teriyaki-konjac.t: Teriyaki-Style Chicken Bowl with Konjac Rice
s: Mix the soy sauce, erythritol, ginger, grated garlic and 3 tbsp water.
Rinse the konjac rice thoroughly, boil it for 2 minutes, then dry-fry it in a pan for 3 minutes.
Cut the chicken into strips and brown it for 6 to 7 minutes in the oil over high heat.
Pour in the sauce and reduce for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring, until syrupy and coating the chicken.
Divide the konjac rice among bowls, add the glazed chicken, sliced cucumber and sliced avocado.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and sliced scallion.
l03-bowl-poulet-teriyaki-konjac.p: Konjac rice is available in supermarkets and Asian grocery stores; replace it with cauliflower rice if needed.

l03-poulet-pesto-tomates-cerises.t: Chicken Pesto Skillet with Cherry Tomatoes
s: Blend the basil, Parmesan, almonds, garlic, 3 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt into a coarse pesto.
Dice the chicken, season with salt and pepper.
Brown it for 7 to 8 minutes in the remaining oil over medium-high heat.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and sauté for 2 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the pesto and the diced mozzarella, mix and serve warm.
l03-poulet-pesto-tomates-cerises.p: The pesto keeps for 5 days in the refrigerator covered with a drizzle of oil.

s: Cut the chicken, bell peppers and onion into thin strips.
Toss the chicken with half of the oil, the spices and salt.
Stir-fry the chicken for 6 minutes over high heat in a large pan, add the vegetables and the remaining oil, and continue for 5 minutes: they should stay slightly crisp.
Mash the avocados with the lime juice, chopped cilantro and salt to make the guacamole.
Divide the lettuce among bowls, add the chicken stir-fry and a generous spoonful of guacamole.
l03-fajitas-bowl-poulet-guacamole.p: Add grated cheese or a spoonful of crème fraîche if you are not avoiding dairy.

s: Grate the zucchini, salt lightly and let it drain for 10 minutes, then squeeze it hard in a tea towel.
Mix the turkey, zucchini, crumbled feta, egg, mint, scallions, cumin and pepper.
Form 8 patties 2 cm thick with wet hands.
Cook them for 6 to 7 minutes on each side in the oil over medium heat, until well browned and cooked through.
Serve in lettuce leaves with a spoonful of lemony Greek yogurt.
l03-burgers-dinde-courgette-feta.p: Squeezing the zucchini well is essential for the patties to hold together.

l03-poulet-satay-cacahuete.t: Chicken Satay Skewers with Peanut Sauce
s: Cut the chicken into strips and marinate for 30 minutes with 100 ml of coconut milk, the spices, half of the soy sauce and the garlic.
Thread the strips accordion-style onto skewers.
Make the sauce: gently heat the remaining coconut milk with the peanut butter, remaining soy sauce and the lime, whisking until smooth.
Grill the skewers on a very hot grill pan for 5 to 6 minutes per side.
Serve with the warm sauce, cucumber sticks, chopped peanuts and cilantro.
l03-poulet-satay-cacahuete.p: Thin the sauce with a little hot water if it thickens too much as it cools.

l03-poulet-grecque-citron-origan.t: Greek-Style Chicken Thighs with Lemon and Oregano
s: Mix the lemon juice and zest, oil, crushed garlic, oregano, salt and pepper. Marinate the thighs in it for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 200°C. Cut the zucchini into large chunks and the onion into wedges.
Arrange the vegetables in a dish, set the thighs on top skin side up and pour over the marinade and broth.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, basting twice with the juices.
Add the olives 10 minutes before the end. The skin should be golden and the cooking juices clear.
Serve with the lemony juices from the dish.
l03-poulet-grecque-citron-origan.p: Add a handful of crumbled feta when it comes out of the oven if you eat dairy.

l03-foies-volaille-creme-moutarde.t: Chicken Livers in Mustard Cream Sauce with Cauliflower Mash
s: Cook the cauliflower florets for 15 minutes in salted water or steam them, drain very well.
Blend with 30 g of butter, the Parmesan, salt and pepper for a smooth mash. Keep warm.
Trim the livers (remove the sinews) and pat dry.
Melt the remaining butter, sweat the sliced onion for 3 minutes, then sear the livers for 2 minutes per side over high heat.
Lower the heat, add the cream and mustard, and simmer for 4 to 5 minutes, until the center of the livers is no longer pink (70°C).
Season with salt and pepper, sprinkle with parsley and serve on the cauliflower mash.
l03-foies-volaille-creme-moutarde.p: Livers are rich in iron and vitamin A: an economical dish to serve once a week.

l03-salade-thai-poulet-concombre.t: Thai Chicken, Cucumber and Mint Salad
s: Poach the breasts for 12 minutes in simmering salted water, let cool slightly, then shred.
Cut the cucumber into thin half-moons and finely shred the red cabbage.
Whisk the lime juice, soy sauce, oil, erythritol and finely chopped chili.
Toss the chicken, vegetables, and the mint and cilantro leaves with the dressing.
Sprinkle with chopped peanuts and serve chilled.
l03-salade-thai-poulet-concombre.p: Remove the chili seeds for a kid-friendly version.
